test_title: PYST 09: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 09 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which of the following letter-clusters should replace # and % so that the pattern and relationship followed between the letter-cluster pair on the left side of :: is the same as that on the right side of ::?

 # : UWC :: OHW : %
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3c600bf09d7de25d7d22479d848ddead62c9f7437c41312681e3719e85d12d.png] 

Given:

# : UWC :: OHW : %

**Option 1) # = KXS, % = SRA**

**For KXS to UWC:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a174e070c53b094f00291a5e3da079a919544c1a045c9088e092309a816eadda.png] 

Pattern for KXS to UWC: (+10, +3, +10)

**For OHW to SRA **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/249ebd5fe0bf017a35dc7fe4fd928eaa597b7a4e54c5e51cfeb84f9a23c69bc9.png] 

The patterns (+10, +3, +10) and (+4, +11, +4) are not the same. So, Option 1 is incorrect.

**Option 2) # = SRA, % = QMY**

**For SRA to UWC:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/205c2db3c9af09d81cbdad42aefcc7d54f3f1c4b08651187d2c88be9cb0784b6.png] 

Pattern for SRA to UWC: (+2, +5, +2)

**For OHW to QMY**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/98b2ca0476d05448a6557b7243087daed2a3acd77883b17f4063c7537959cf72.png] 

**Pattern for OHW to QMY: (+2, +5, +2). **

**This pattern matches the pattern for SRA to UWC!**

**Option 3) # = QMY, % = MCU**

**For QMY to UWC:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b140fc36472bf5986c8912a6aaca5ea4d7524bc3865e391fc52c22645df603f2.png] 

Pattern for QMY to UWC: (+4, +10, +4)

**For OHW to MCU **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0242ca9cbbf620e3d4918918b6838d55a8ee28892781370885adfb9cdb46df84.png] 

The patterns (+4, +10, +4) and (-2, -5, -2) are not the same. So, Option 3 is incorrect.

**Option 4) # = MCU, % = KXS**

**For MCU to UWC:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6cee4976d98eeda1247fc7cf8d51ab0d3bd127b8ffc47383023e4a82f4d8c5d1.png] 

Pattern for MCU to UWC: (+8, +20, +8)

**For OHW to KXS**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5caac9455e7068ba7f2163d8a7b82a42f4edb2865ac7d4880d933ffb46cfc8e4.png] 

The patterns (+8, +20, +8) and (-4, +16, -4) are not the same. So, Option 4 is incorrect.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.
